title: A debt close reads the PR's own CI result for the suite its Retire line names, so `merge --ready` does not run hooks/test_guard.py a second time
why: Ask (consultant 15:00 CST, relayed by the coordinator 15:07; not built; triage read no code): the debt-close lint runs hooks/test_guard.py, about 39 min (measured once), inside `merge --ready`, and then the PR's CI runs the same suite. Rule roles-each-layer-proves-once: CI is the merge check, each layer proves a change once. Design point (coordinator): `--ready` runs before the PR's own CI run exists, so reading CI needs a different place for the check, or another source, such as the draft touched-tests run. Kin: ready-step-hang-no-timeout (the heartbeat only; the family selector is parked there), ready-checks-time-bound. A change that moves a refusal to a pass on weaker evidence is a widening: it is not built without a `Departs from:` line to the coordinator, and an owner question if it widens. First act of a lane: read lint/check_debt_retire.py judge_close, name which run a close can read and when it exists, then propose; red then green only after the coordinator picks. OWNER WORDS 15:11 CST Nov 14 (consultant, owner 15:06 CST Nov 14, verbatim, relayed by the coordinator 15:09; a question in chat, not an answer to a page item): "if the test runs on the machine abd it covers everything ci will the it shd skip ci right (whatever maximized speed via cutting repetition)". Consultant's design reading (unmeasured; not the owner's words): one proof per tree per OS, in whichever place is fastest. For the debt-close check that place is CI (sharded, no queue block): move it after the PR's ready run and read that run's result, so the local 39-min run goes. A local run replaces a CI job only when it posts a status bound to the exact tree and OS (degen's native-check poster is the pattern). RULE CHECK (triage): no filed ruling covers this. Rule roles-each-layer-proves-once says each layer proves a change once, and ruling push-skip-proven-tree skips a push run on a proven tree; neither covers a local run replacing a CI job. R37 (no fixed limits) is about word counts, not this. So it is the owner's direction in chat, not yet a ruling: it becomes one when he answers a page question on the design.
